label: QR Stamp
description: Drop a QR onto any image or video. Same engine as the auto post-render watermark, exposed for direct use.

mediaPath.label: Media
mediaPath.description: Image or video to brand with a QR stamp.

text.label: QR payload
text.description: Text encoded into the QR — URL, plain string, or structured payload (default: https://www.m0saic.io).

sizePct.label: Size (%)
sizePct.description: Stamp size as a percent of min(W, H).

marginPct.label: Margin (%)
marginPct.description: Margin between stamp and corner edges, % of min(W, H).

mode.label: Card mode
mode.description: QR card mode. 'auto' uses scene luminance to pick light vs dark.

luminanceBuckets.label: Luminance override
luminanceBuckets.description: Luminance-bucket override for auto mode. Omit to let the template probe the stamp corner itself (real renders only — design previews skip analysis and fall back to the light card).

moduleStyle.label: Module Style
moduleStyle.description: Module shape: circle dots (the branded default), roundedSquare, or square (the classic matrix look).

center.label: Centre
center.description: What the carved centre holds: the m0saic M (the branded default), your own asset (pick it below), or off for a plain code.

centerAsset.label: Centre asset
centerAsset.description: Image or video that fills the centre safe area when Centre is 'asset' — contain-fit, over the card colour.
